name: Liberty
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Liberty for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, at least 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 1 (How the Grinch Stole Storytime at Kearney Library) through December 12 (Kearney's Magical Night and Lighted Christmas Parade), with Santa and Mrs. Claus at the Withers Library (December 7) along the way, plus Hometown Holidays, Santa's Mailbox and a breakfast with Santa already live. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Liberty

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Liberty, counting 3 already live and 3 new ones, 2 of them from nearby Kearney
  • At least 2 free events: Hometown Holidays and Kearney's Magical Night and Lighted Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Storytime with Santa and Mrs. Claus at Withers Library, Santa's Mailbox, breakfast with Santa and Mrs. Claus, and pictures with Santa and the Grinch at Kearney's Magical Night
  • Parades and tree lightings: Hometown Holidays and Mayor's Tree Lighting, and the Kearney Lighted Christmas Parade with fireworks (December 12)
  • Season: December 1, 2026 to December 12, 2026 for the new listings

Planning a bigger day out? Liberty families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Kansas City, which covers Destination North Pole at Crown Center, Holiday Reflections at Union Station, the Plaza lighting ceremony and Santa visits at Zona Rosa.
